company: Kaggle Inc. (a subsidiary of Google LLC)

ownership.quote: Kaggle is a data science competition platform and online community for data scientists and machine learning practitioners under Google LLC.

stage.quote: On March 8, 2017, Fei-Fei Li, Chief Scientist at Google, announced that Google was acquiring Kaggle.
stage.note: Kaggle operated as an independent startup (raising a $12.5M round in 2011) before being acquired by Google in March 2017; it now operates as part of Google/Google Cloud, so funding-stage tracking effectively stopped at acquisition.

total_funding_usd.basis: Wikipedia citing reporting on Kaggle's 2011 financing round (pre-Google-acquisition total); no additional priced rounds are documented after 2011 before the 2017 Google acquisition.
total_funding_usd.quote: In 2011, the company raised $12.5 million and Max Levchin became the chairman.

last_round.quote: On March 8, 2017, Fei-Fei Li, Chief Scientist at Google, announced that Google was acquiring Kaggle.

note: Kaggle was founded in 2010 by Anthony Goldbloom, raised a $12.5M round in 2011 (Max Levchin became chairman), and was acquired by Google in March 2017 (announced by Fei-Fei Li). It now operates as a free data-science/ML community and notebook platform under Google; not a standalone funded startup, so 'total funding' and 'last round' reflect its pre-acquisition history only, and current revenue is folded into Alphabet's overall financials.
